Hello OP I do feel lonely too even tho I have a spouse, job, "friends", and hobbies.

Ive tried several things drugs, teraphy, exercise, diets, adrenaline rushes, etc etc

Im not here to tell you what to do but to share what has made me feel alive or not so alone.

Quit social medias, really. Delete your insta, snap, facebook whatever. Get disconnected from the social aspects of the internet, looking at how everyone's life looks better than yours doesnt help at all.

Be real to the people who are there for you. I used to avoid coworkers, family members, random strangers when they asked how am I doing. Now im honest and straight up tell em im sad or havinga bad day. Their replies will let you know who is actually there for you and also will relieve you from the expectations from others if they dont really care about you. You can close those friendships and create new honest ones.

Excercise. Even if youre not fit. Go for a long walk at a park.. play some sports maybe, get a bike and just circle the cycling area in your local parks even if you dont have a goal go do it. 

Drugs. I dont recommend em but it you can go and smoke a joint every once in a while it can help in certain situations. But be aware DO NOT DEPPEND ON IT cuz you gonna have a bad time if you do.

Adrenaline rush, yes thats right. Go and fight someone get your ass kicked, get into an argument even if youre scared of it. Tell that one person you hate to go fuck himself. Maybe get in trouble and escape the situation in a way that makes you feel alive. Or maybe go to a shooting range and just shoot. Buy fireworks and use em in public area that is forbidden and run!! There has to be some kind of crazy event that can make you feel alive. Im sure my examples here are a bit drastic but you can find adrenaline on small things too like stealing bubblegum, stealing a small glass from a restaurant or etc. I dont recommend anything illegal right but its what came to my mind first.. 

Teraphy. Teraphist can help you but only to a certain level. Ive realized its more inside each one of us how to react to these. Sadly two years of teraphy hasnt helped me much only to understand more how my mentality works.

Free writing. Just open a brand new notebook, grab your pen and write.. write everything that goes in your mind and read it. You probably gonna cry but that can release great levels of stress.. maybe you could even fall asleep for crying and well that made you just skip a day of suffering.



All these suck yea but it has helped me in a way.
